description: A brand's customer personas: who it markets to, their age range and awareness stage, with the angles and offers aimed at each. Each persona is a segment nickname, the buyer's situation in their words, its share of the brand's ads, how many ads and landing pages speak to it, and its top angles and offers. Empty until the brand has enough ads and pages read. Use it to answer 'who is this brand selling to' or to compare two brands' audiences. Fields this workspace can't see are null and named in the item's `locked` list (`estimates` = sales, visits, traffic). A capped list sets `planLimit` (`maxResults`, `hiddenResults`) and has no next page. Never estimate omitted values. Returns data only, shown to no one. Once you know the answer, call sightglass_show once with this resultId to show it as cards; it doesn't search again. For multi-step competitor research, call skills with name "replo".

companyRef.description: Company id or slug. Users call companies 'brands'.

projectId.description: Replo project id, from list_projects. Its workspace decides which Sightglass fields and history come back. Only tools that say they save something (an asset or a Canvas file) write to this project.

workspaceId.description: Replo workspace id, from list_workspaces. Decides which workspace's Sightglass fields and history come back; required when the user has more than one workspace.

name: sightglass_find_personas
title: Find a brand's personas
